creative_premise: An authored typographic field in which every word is lent a manipulable direction of gravity; the visitor tilts, freezes, scatters, and resets the archive without accounts, storage, networking, or sound.

verification.method: node --test against the exact source and contract prepared for commit
claims_supported: source contract rejects network, storage, analytics, authentication, commerce, and autoplay dependencies
pointer and keyboard interaction paths are present
live status, pressed state, and 44px minimum controls are present
device-pixel-ratio and frame delta are bounded
page-exit animation cancellation and pointer-cancel handling are present
reduced-motion state freezes simulation and no sound API is required

privacy_boundary: No private source material, visitor data, persistent storage, analytics, authentication, commerce, or external service calls are present.
independence_boundary: The work is a self-contained kinetic typography instrument and does not explain, implement, or visually imitate Mirror Cartographer.
